Name: Red Panda Bazaar
Author: Lilaoliu
Description:
[center][b][size=6]English[/size][/b]
[spoiler] Red Panda Bazaar is a brand-new area mod that brings new locations, NPCs, festivals, and content to Stardew Valley.

[size=5][b]New NPCs[/b][/size]
Adds distinctive NPCs.

[size=5][b]New Location[/b][/size]
A signboard has been placed next to the bus stop, allowing you to enter Red Panda Bazaar.
The bazaar is filled with shops offering a variety of goods, so you can always find what you need at any stage of the game.
There's also a prize machine — you can purchase tickets from a certain NPC's shop.

[size=5][b]New Food[/b][/size]
Adds a variety of new foods, some with special buffs to aid and enrich your journey.
Most of the new recipes can be purchased at the coffee shop.

[size=5][b]New Festival[/b][/size]
A new festival arrives on Spring 8: the Spring Fair.
During the fair, Red Panda and the folks of Pelican Town set up stalls to sell their wares.
You can also play minigames to earn star tokens and exchange them for rewards!

[size=5][b]New Decor[/b][/size]
Adds new furniture and clothing for more ways to personalize your experience!

[size=5][b]Future Plans[/b][/size]
More NPCs, more events, more minigames, and more creativity!
An autumn festival is on the horizon — perhaps even with visitors from Kivotos.

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Red Panda Bazaar is compatible with SVE, RSV, and East Scarp.
It is also compatible with Qingfeng - Custom NPC (this mod is no longer updated; installing both will result in two Qingfengs).
Red Panda Bazaar supports Central Station, allowing you to travel by transit.
If you run into any bugs, please let us know!

[center][b][size=6]中文[/size][/b][/center]
[center][spoiler]小熊猫集市是一个全新的区域模组，为星露谷增添了新的地点、NPC、节日和内容。

[size=5][b]新NPC[/b][/size]
添加了多个性格鲜明、可社交的NPC。

[size=5][b]新地点[/b][/size]
在公交车旁添加了一块竖牌，可通过其进入小熊猫集市。
集市内有很多商店，售卖各不相同的物品，在游戏的不同时期都可以买到需要的东西。
集市添加了一个抽奖机，可以从某个NPC的商店购买获得抽奖券。

[size=5][b]新食物[/b][/size]
添加了很多新食物，部分食物具有特殊Buff，为你的游戏进程添加乐趣和帮助。
绝大多数新增的食物配方都可以在咖啡屋购买。

[size=5][b]新节日[/b][/size]
在春季第8天添加了一个新节日：春季展览会。
届时小熊猫和鹈鹕镇的居民们会来此售卖各自的商品。
你也可以游玩小游戏获取星星币来兑换奖励！

[size=5][b]新装饰[/b][/size]
添加了一些新家具和新衣服，给予你更多的个性化选择！

[size=5][b]未来计划[/b][/size]
更多NPC、更多事件、更多小游戏和更多创意！
秋季的节日，甚至会有来自基沃托斯的游客。

[size=5][b]兼容性[/b][/size]
Red Panda Bazaar 与 SVE、RSV 和 East Scarp 兼容。
Red Panda Bazaar 也兼容 Qingfeng - Custom NPC（此Mod已停更，同时安装会看到两个 Qingfeng）。
Red Panda Bazaar 已适配 Central Station，你可以乘坐交通工具往返。
如果你发现任何Bug，欢迎提交给我们！
